clubs.name: National Cadet Corps (NCC)
clubs.summary: Discipline, leadership and service under the motto "Unity and Discipline".

clubs.name: National Service Scheme (NSS)
clubs.summary: Community service and social responsibility through the NSS.
clubs.description: National Service Scheme volunteers take part in community service programmes.

clubs.name: Astronomy Club
clubs.summary: Exploring the night sky, space science and the universe.
clubs.description: The Astronomy Club brings together students curious about the sky above Pollachi. Members learn to read star charts, identify constellations and planets, and follow space missions and celestial events.
activities: Talks on space science and space missions
Watching eclipses, meteor showers and planetary events

clubs.name: Martial Arts Club
clubs.summary: Self-defence, discipline and fitness through martial arts.
clubs.description: The Martial Arts Club trains students in self-defence and traditional martial arts, building fitness, confidence, focus and discipline.

clubs.name: Fine Arts Club
clubs.summary: A space for drawing, painting, craft and creative expression.
clubs.description: The Fine Arts Club encourages students to express themselves through drawing, painting, sketching, rangoli, craft and design.
activities: Campus decoration for festivals and events

clubs.name: Rotaract Club
clubs.summary: Young leaders in service, fellowship and professional growth.
clubs.description: The Rotaract Club connects students with the Rotary movement to develop leadership, take part in community service projects and build professional skills.

clubs.name: Photography Club
clubs.summary: Learn to see, frame and tell stories with a camera.
clubs.description: The Photography Club is for students who enjoy capturing people, places and moments. Members learn composition, lighting and editing, and help document life on campus.

clubs.name: Anti-Drug Club
clubs.summary: Awareness and peer support for a drug-free campus and community.
clubs.description: The Anti-Drug Club works to keep the campus and community free from drugs and substance abuse through awareness, peer education and positive alternatives such as sports and the arts.
activities: Awareness campaigns, rallies and street plays
Talks by doctors, counsellors and police officers
Observance of the International Day Against Drug Abuse

clubs.name: Book Readers Club
clubs.summary: For students who love books, reading and discussion.
clubs.description: The Book Readers Club promotes the reading habit among students. Members read, review and discuss books of all kinds, supported by the college library.

clubs.name: Animal Welfare Club
clubs.summary: Compassion and care for animals on campus and beyond.
clubs.description: The Animal Welfare Club encourages kindness towards animals and responsible care for the stray animals and birds around the campus.
activities: Feeding points and water bowls for birds and animals
Awareness drives on animal care and adoption
Support for rescue and vaccination drives

clubs.name: Cultural Club
clubs.summary: Music, dance, drama and the cultural life of the campus.
clubs.description: The Cultural Club organises and promotes music, dance, drama and other performing arts, and is behind much of the colour of college cultural events and celebrations.
activities: Talent shows and annual day programmes

clubs.name: Road Safety Club
clubs.summary: Promoting safe roads, helmets and responsible driving.
clubs.description: The Road Safety Club promotes road safety awareness among students, staff and the neighbouring community, with a focus on helmets, seat belts, traffic rules and responsible driving.
activities: Workshops with traffic police and first-aid training

clubs.name: Entrepreneurship Club
clubs.summary: Ideas, start-ups and an enterprising mindset.
clubs.description: The Entrepreneurship Club nurtures an enterprising mindset. Students work on business ideas, meet entrepreneurs and learn how to take an idea towards a start-up, working closely with the Institution's Innovation Council (IIC).
activities: Talks by entrepreneurs and industry experts

clubs.name: Natural Club
clubs.summary: Protecting the environment and the green campus.
clubs.description: The Natural Club encourages students to protect and enjoy the environment.

clubs.name: Tamil Mandram
clubs.summary: Tamil language, literature and culture.
clubs.description: Tamil Mandram celebrates Tamil language, literature and culture.

clubs.name: Coding Club
clubs.summary: Programming, problem solving and technology.
clubs.description: The Coding Club helps students build programming and problem-solving skills.

clubs.name: English Literary Club
clubs.summary: English language, literature and communication.
clubs.description: The English Literary Club develops communication skills and a love of English language and literature.

clubs.name: Science Club
clubs.summary: Curiosity, experiments and scientific temper.
clubs.description: The Science Club encourages scientific curiosity and hands-on learning.

clubs.name: Youth Red Cross (YRC)
clubs.summary: Humanitarian service, health and first aid.
clubs.description: The Youth Red Cross wing promotes humanitarian service, health and first-aid awareness.

clubs.name: Sports Club
clubs.summary: Cricket, athletics, indoor games and the gym.
clubs.description: The Sports Club provides facilities and opportunities for outdoor and indoor sports.
